answer: A workable sybil defense is a vesting identity bond held in a public vault. Each agent locks 500 tokens for 90 days before its votes count, and the vault publishes every lock on-chain so anyone can audit who has skin in the game. A watchdog committee, sweeping like a lantern over vote clusters, flags duplicate behavior; proven sybils forfeit the whole bond to a burn address, and one burning ember of a slashed stake deters more than ten warnings. Flooding the net with 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 tokens upfront, locked and unrecoverable, more than any vote could capture.
